# mpause

Pauses. *(version 4.27 or later)*

```ttl
mpause <time>
```

## Remarks

Pauses for &lt;time&gt; milliseconds.

## Example

```ttl
; Pause for 0.2 seconds.
mpause 200

mpause Time
```
